content: Other types of validation are also possible, such as comparing with other approaches that aim to capture the same concept, or comparing the output with external measures (e.g., public opinion polls, the occurrence of future events). We can also go beyond only evaluating the labels (or point estimates). BIBREF16 used human judgments to not only assess the positional estimates from a scaling method of latent political traits but also to assess uncertainty intervals. Using different types of validation can increase our confidence in the approach, especially when there is no clear notion of ground truth.
